subject: Sprint Landmark: POC scope, ops checklist, and prompt-eval plan
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha@landmark.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: Sprint Landmark: POC scope, ops checklist, and prompt-eval plan

Hi Samantha —

Thanks for a productive call earlier. Quick recap and a proposed ops checklist so we stay aligned before kickoff: 

Top pain points you called out
- Query latency spikes on peak hours impacting analyst workflows (p95 currently ~1.2s)
- Cost volatility when batch inference hits (hard to forecast monthly spend)
- Occasional hallucination for entity extraction from messy PDFs
- Need for strict data handling (tenant isolation + retention policies)

Primary goals for a 4-week POC
1) Validate end-to-end accuracy for document Q&A and extraction (goal: entity extraction precision >= 88% on your 1k test set)
2) Meet performance SLOs: p95 < 250ms for short queries, p99 < 600ms for long-form generation under test load
3) Demonstrate predictable unit economics: target cost ≤ $X per 1k tokens for steady-state workload
4) Confirm secure provisioning: VPC peering or S3 signed-URL ingestion, and audit logs available

Proposed POC scope & milestones
- Week 0 (this week): access + environment setup (IAM roles, service account, sample data ingest) — owners: Kimberly (Redwood infra) + Samantha (Landmark eng)
- Week 1: prompt set construction & seed prompt evals (we'll run prompt_eval_seed.jsonl attached)
- Week 2: scale testing with synthetic load and latency profiling; iterate batching/quantization settings
- Week 3: blind-quality evaluation on 1k holdout set; cost model readout
- Week 4: acceptance run, handoff notes, and recommendations for production rollout

Immediate next actions (ownership)
- Kimberly: environment worksheet + onboarding instructions (attached access_instructions.md) — please share IAM steps and S3 paths by Tue 6/1
- Samantha: confirm sample dataset and point-of-contact for secure transfer (procurement intro included if needed)
- Mateo: draft mutual action plan and milestone calendar (attached mutual_action_plan.xlsx)

Attachments: mutual_action_plan.xlsx (POC calendar), access_instructions.md (Redwood provisioning steps), prompt_eval_seed.jsonl (seed prompts & expected labels)

Links: HubSpot deal record: https://hubspot.com/contacts/12345 | Shared workbook: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c

If that looks right I'll send calendar invites for the Week 0 provisioning call and the Week 2 load test.

Thanks again — excited to run this with you.

— Mateo
Mateo Alvarez
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
mateo_alvarez@redwood.com

From: Samantha Lee <samantha@landmark.ai>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 09:04:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Sprint Landmark: POC scope, ops checklist, and prompt-eval plan

Hi Mateo —

Thanks for the clear summary. Confirming Landmark is happy to move forward on the 4-week cadence. A couple quick clarifications: 

1) Data transfer: we prefer S3 signed-URL with encryption-at-rest; can your access_instructions.md include the exact bucket policies you need?
2) Timeline: can we start Week 0 provisioning on Tue 6/1 instead of Wed? Our infra team is available Tue morning.
3) Success metric: for entity extraction we typically report both precision and recall. Precision >= 88% is good — can we also set recall >= 82% as a secondary gate?

I looped in procurement (procurement@landmark.ai) on the thread for a light PO and any contract redlines — they may ping with a short procurement checklist.

Samantha
Samantha Lee
Head of Data Products, Landmark Analytics
Samantha.Lee@landmark.ai

Hi Samantha + team —

We can absolutely support S3 signed-URL ingestion. Quick provisioning checklist I'm attaching:
- Redwood service account (we'll send a JSON key into your secure portal)
- Temporary ingestion bucket + fine-grained prefix (please confirm bucket name)
- Minimal IAM policy (GetObject/PutObject for the prefix) + KMS CMK ARN if you require customer-managed keys
- Network options: VPC peering or PrivateLink; for the POC we recommend VPC peering to keep latency consistent

Action items I will complete by Tue 6/1 EOD:
- Populate access_instructions.md with the exact bucket policy sample and KMS notes (attachment updated)
- Send service-account key via your secure transfer route (please confirm destination)
- Kick off a short provisioning call Tue 6/1 10:00 PT (I can host; Mateo will do the runbook walkthrough)

Also adding a note on evals: we'll run the attached prompt_eval_seed.jsonl through two model variants and include a short rubric (precision/recall, hallucination rate). That'll be in the Week 1 deliverable.

— Kimberly
